ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (white/cream) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous high-intensity white/cream blobs are positioned in the center of the left and right lobes, separated by a dominant low-intensity black central region extending from the peduncle to the median notch. Low-intensity black pixels also define the leading and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing edge exhibiting high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) across the entire boundary, with increased irregularity near the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe edges follow a strong convex upward and outward sweep from the center, transitioning to a slight concavity along the distal third of the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, raised, high-contrast pixel clusters (calcified textures) localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Scattered individual white circular pixel anomalies are detected across the central low-intensity region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (vertical and diagonal scratches) are visible, particularly crossing the transition zones between high and low intensity pigmentation on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of raised, textured anomalies at the distal trailing edge tips and numerous dispersed circular depigmented marks across the central black pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-tan pixel staining observed within the primary high-intensity white regions on both fluke lobes.
